'''G0-T0-Telerath''' was a [[G0-T0 infrastructure planning system|G0-T0 Infrastructure-Planning droid]] developed by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]] assigned to serve as a central organizational hub for the planet [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]]. It was one of many G0-T0 droids whose memories were corrupted by the massive amounts of data flowing through them, inadvertently creating personalities and independent motivations. G0-T0-Telerath temporarily took control of one of the galaxy's largest financial institutions and caused an economic emergency when it demanded control of the [[Coruscant Financial Exchange]].
